rpm_definition: Creator revenue per 1,000 total views after YouTube revenue share; may include ads, YouTube Premium, memberships, Super Chat and Super Stickers.

inputs.usd_try_method: Midpoint of TCMB 2026-08-20 indicative forex buying 47.8642 and selling 47.9504

sources.title: Indicative Exchange Rates — 20 August 2026
sources.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye

limitations: Only the channel owner can see actual historical RPM and revenue in YouTube Studio.
Applying a 2026 RPM scenario to lifetime views assumes a constant historical rate; actual RPM, monetization eligibility, geography and ad demand changed over time.

The live-channel estimate uses Social Blade's 946-video, 1.0007-billion-view snapshot. The per-word estimate instead uses the internally consistent 849-video analyzed catalog because transcript words are unavailable for the extra live-channel videos.
TRY values are current-rate equivalents, not the historical lira amounts received when revenue was earned.
Taxes, sponsorships, brand deals, merchandise, affiliate income, courses, speaking and other off-platform income are excluded.
Revenue per word is a playful normalization, not a causal claim that individual words generated equal revenue.
